acceptance: `execution.timeout_minutes` is either removed with the removed-key message and a breaking-change changelog entry, or kept with its real reader recorded.
context: Raised during the run-timeout effort (owner asked for this follow-up, 2026-11-22). See run-timeout-plan-20261120.
description:
## Problem
`execution.timeout_minutes` (default 120) is set in `SimpleConfigProvider` defaults but has no reader outside tests. It promises a limit that nothing enforces, the same defect the run-timeout effort removed for `benchmarks.timeout_minutes`, `execution.power_run.timeout_per_iteration_minutes` and `execution.concurrent_queries.query_timeout_seconds`. It was not one of those three named keys, so the removal of unused timers left it in place.

## Change
1. Re-verify on current develop that nothing reads or enforces `execution.timeout_minutes` (product code, scripts, docs, examples; its own tests do not count), with language-server references and grep, and list the evidence.
2. If it has no real reader, remove the key and its default, add it to the removed-key handling so a config file that still sets it gets the existing message verbatim: "`{key}` is no longer used and has no effect. Use `execution.timeout_seconds` to limit a run.", and add a breaking-change changelog fragment naming it.
3. If it has a real reader, keep it and record what reads it.

## Verification rubric
The references evidence is in the pull request; loading a config file that sets the key prints the message and does not crash (test); `make pr-preflight` exits 0.
